leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a linked list data structure using JavaScript classes
Initialize a linked list with multiple nodes for testing reversal
Manipulate node pointers to reverse the direction of a linked list
Implement an iterative algorithm to reverse a linked list
Apply pointer reassignment logic to traverse and modify the list
Control the reversal process by managing previous, current, and next pointers
Integrate the reversal function into a complete working program
